career_house_nature.1: Self-driven, entrepreneurial; career fused with identity.
career_house_nature.2: Banking, family profession, speech and resource-based income.
career_house_nature.3: Communication, IT, media, writing, technical trade, short-range skills.
career_house_nature.5: Education, creative fields, coaching, investment-linked work.
career_house_nature.6: Service sector, employment, healthcare, legal service roles.
career_house_nature.9: Consulting, teaching, international links, advisory or legal authority.
career_house_nature.10: Strong public role; career as central life theme.
career_house_nature.11: Network-driven career, corporate gains, large-organisation work.
career_house_nature.12: Foreign posting, institutions, behind-the-scenes or export work.

csl_planet.Sun: Authority, visibility, government links, father-theme, leadership.
csl_planet.Moon: Public mood, nurture, food, data, travel cycles, caregiving industries.
csl_planet.Mars: Competition, engineering, surgery, property, acute events, courage.
csl_planet.Mercury: Commerce, writing, contracts, analytics, IT communication, trade.
csl_planet.Jupiter: Teaching, ethics, law, counsel, gradual expansion, dharma.
csl_planet.Venus: Arts, comfort, contracts, diplomacy, luxury, partnership grace.
csl_planet.Saturn: Slow proof, duty, delay, structure, chronic themes, discipline.
csl_planet.Rahu: Foreign, unconventional, tech, media, sudden swings, ambition.
csl_planet.Ketu: Detachment, research, spiritual refit, endings, specialist depth.

health.title: Illness
health.text: The 6th house is primary for disease; CSL of 6th connecting 1st can bring illness. Malefics strengthen; benefics give relief.

health.title: Recovery
health.text: Recovery is seen when the 6th connects with the 11th. Benefics like Jupiter or Mercury enhance healing.

health.title: Chronic Diseases
health.text: 6th linked with Saturn or Rahu brings long-term or hard-to-diagnose illness.

marriage.title: Marriage Promise
marriage.text: Marriage is promised when the 7th house connects with the 2nd and 11th houses. Venus and Jupiter support this promise.

marriage.title: Divorce or Separation
marriage.text: If the 7th house connects with the 6th and 12th, marriage suffers divorce or permanent separation.

marriage.title: Happy Married Life
marriage.text: Benefics like Jupiter and Venus influencing the 7th, 2nd, and 11th ensure harmony and lasting happiness.

children.title: Childbirth Promise
children.text: The 5th house connecting 2nd and 11th assures childbirth. Jupiter and Venus as karakas bring blessings of children.

children.title: Delay in Progeny
children.text: Saturn influencing the 5th delays childbirth. Rahu creates hurdles in conception.

children.title: Adoption/IVF
children.text: 5th house with Rahu and Mercury indicates unconventional childbirth like IVF or adoption.

modern_career.title: Illness
modern_career.text: The 6th house is the primary house of diseases, while the 1st house represents the physical body. If the CSL of the 6th connects with the 1st, the native may suffer from illness. Malefic planets like Saturn and Mars strengthen this tendency, whereas benefics like Jupiter can provide relief.

modern_career.title: Hospitalization
modern_career.text: The 12th house indicates confinement and isolation. When it combines with the 1st (body) and 6th (disease), the result is hospitalization. Saturn and Ketu are natural karakas for hospital stays, showing detachment from normal life due to illness.

modern_career.title: Accidents
modern_career.text: The 8th house is the house of sudden events and accidents. When linked with the 12th (loss, hospital) and malefics such as Mars or Rahu, the native may face accidents or injuries. In DBA periods of these planets, and when transit Moon triggers the 8th, accidents often occur.

modern_career.title: Longevity (Long, Medium, Short Life)
modern_career.text: The 8th house determines life span, supported by the 1st (body) and 3rd (vitality). Benefics like Jupiter and Venus linked with these houses assure long life. Mixed influences give medium life, while malefics like Saturn, Mars, and Rahu dominating the 8th reduce longevity.

modern_career.title: Maraka Influence
modern_career.text: The 2nd and 7th houses are maraka houses. When these are activated in connection with the 8th, danger to life arises. Malefics in their DBA may trigger critical periods.

modern_career.title: Recovery from Disease
modern_career.text: Recovery and cure are seen when the 6th house connects with the 11th, the house of fulfilment and success. Benefics like Jupiter or Mercury enhance healing and ensure victory over illness.

modern_career.title: Chronic Diseases
modern_career.text: When the 6th house is strongly linked with Saturn (delays, chronicity) or Rahu (mysterious ailments), the native suffers from long-term illnesses. These diseases often lack easy diagnosis and continue for extended periods.

modern_career.title: Hidden/Unknown Diseases
modern_career.text: The 6th house connected with the 12th shows diseases that remain undiagnosed or hidden for long. Ketu also plays a major role, bringing unusual or spiritual causes for health problems.

modern_career.title: Stable Wealth
modern_career.text: The 2nd house is the primary house of wealth. When it connects with the 6th (daily earnings), 10th (profession), and 11th (gains), the native enjoys stable financial growth. Jupiter and Mercury strengthen this combination, ensuring prosperity.

modern_career.title: Loss of Wealth
modern_career.text: If the 2nd house connects with the 8th (sudden loss) and 12th (expenditure), wealth diminishes. Malefics like Saturn and Rahu in these houses may cause theft, unnecessary expenses, or sudden financial setbacks.

modern_career.title: Speculation Gains
modern_career.text: Profits from speculation, gambling, or shares come when the 5th house (risk-taking) combines with the 2nd, 6th, and 11th. Mercury (intellect) and Rahu (sudden results) play important roles. With benefics, speculation brings gains; with malefics, it brings losses.

modern_career.title: Lottery Success
modern_career.text: Lottery and sudden financial windfalls are seen when the 11th house combines with the 2nd, 3rd, and 6th houses. Venus and Rahu often support such combinations, giving unexpected gains during their DBA.

six_steps: Note planets that own or occupy these houses.
Check each planet's star lord - add houses ruled by that star lord.
Examine the planet's sub lord - confirm or deny promise.
Cross-check the Cuspal Sub Lord of relevant houses.

health_csl.chronic: If the 6th cusp sub lord signifies houses 6, 8, and/or 12, chronic or serious illness tendency is indicated (Ravichandran).
health_csl.recovery: If the 6th cusp sub lord signifies houses 1, 5, and/or 9, constitution tends toward quicker recovery.
health_csl.eighth_recovery: 8th cusp sub lord signifying 1, 5, 9 supports recovery after health scares.
